job.sentence: Nothing structural is new here: every frame and every side of every split in play has been seen before. The job is lexical — 4 new lego(s): "tomorrow" → "mañana", "to guess" → "adivinar", "what's going to happen" → "lo que va a pasar", "I wouldn't like" → "no me gustaría".

phrases.known_text: I'm going to try tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Voy a intentar mañana
phrases.why: introduces mañana in final position off the going-to frame

phrases.known_text: I'd like to speak tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Me gustaría hablar mañana
phrases.why: swaps matrix to want-chain, new right-of-mañana context via a different verb

phrases.known_text: I want to practise speaking tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Quiero practicar hablando mañana
phrases.why: adds a gerund complement before mañana, new left neighbour

phrases.known_text: I'd like to be able to speak Spanish tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Me gustaría poder hablar español mañana
phrases.why: stacks be-able-to before the verb, lengthening the clause that precedes mañana

phrases.known_text: I'm going to try to say something in Spanish tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Voy a intentar decir algo en español mañana
phrases.why: object plus language phrase gives mañana a new immediate left neighbour, español

phrases.known_text: I'm going to practise speaking with another person tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Voy a practicar hablando con otra persona mañana
phrases.why: another-person object before mañana, new left neighbour persona

phrases.known_text: I want to be able to explain what I want to say tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Quiero poder explicar lo que quiero decir mañana
phrases.why: embeds an object clause before mañana, left neighbour decir

phrases.known_text: I want to try to explain what I want to say tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Quiero intentar explicar lo que quiero decir mañana
phrases.why: same embedded clause, different chain verb intentar, varies matrix signature

phrases.known_text: I'm going to try to remember a word in Spanish tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Voy a intentar recordar una palabra en español mañana
phrases.why: new verb recordar and object una palabra as left context for mañana

phrases.known_text: I'd like to practise speaking a little Spanish tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Me gustaría practicar hablando un poco de español mañana
phrases.why: quantified object un poco de español gives mañana a fresh left neighbour

phrases.known_text: I'd like to speak with you tomorrow as frequently as possible
phrases.target_text: Me gustaría hablar contigo mañana lo más frecuentemente posible
phrases.why: trailing as-as adjunct moves mañana out of final position into medial, the only non-final exemplar

phrases.known_text: I want to be able to guess
phrases.target_text: Quiero poder adivinar
phrases.why: introduces adivinar as the bare complement of a want-be-able-to chain

phrases.known_text: I'm going to try to guess tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Voy a intentar adivinar mañana
phrases.why: places adivinar medially between intentar and mañana, new right neighbour

phrases.known_text: I'd like to guess how to say something
phrases.target_text: Me gustaría adivinar cómo decir algo
phrases.why: gives adivinar an embedded-question complement, new right neighbour cómo

phrases.known_text: I'm going to try to guess something in Spanish tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Voy a intentar adivinar algo en español mañana
phrases.why: direct object algo after adivinar, contrasts with the embedded-question use

phrases.known_text: I'd like to guess how to say something in Spanish today
phrases.target_text: Me gustaría adivinar cómo decir algo en español hoy
phrases.why: extends the embedded-question use with a language and time tail

phrases.known_text: I'd like to be able to guess how to say something in Spanish
phrases.target_text: Me gustaría poder adivinar cómo decir algo en español
phrases.why: inserts poder before adivinar, new left neighbour poder

phrases.known_text: I want to try to guess what I want to say in Spanish
phrases.target_text: Quiero intentar adivinar lo que quiero decir en español
phrases.why: swaps the complement to the lo que quiero decir clause, new right neighbour lo

phrases.known_text: I want to be able to guess what I want to say with another person
phrases.target_text: Quiero poder adivinar lo que quiero decir con otra persona
phrases.why: same clause complement but with poder chain and a companion phrase, matrix varies

phrases.known_text: I'd like to try to guess how to explain what I want to say
phrases.target_text: Me gustaría intentar adivinar cómo explicar lo que quiero decir
phrases.why: double-embeds explicar inside the how-clause after adivinar, longest right context

phrases.known_text: I'm going to try to guess how to say a word in Spanish tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Voy a intentar adivinar cómo decir una palabra en español mañana
phrases.why: combines going-to matrix with the embedded question and a trailing time adjunct

phrases.known_text: What's going to happen
phrases.target_text: Lo que va a pasar
phrases.why: introduces the LEGO alone as a bare embedded-question fragment

phrases.known_text: I want to guess what's going to happen
phrases.target_text: Quiero adivinar lo que va a pasar
phrases.why: places the LEGO as the object of adivinar, final position

phrases.known_text: I'm going to try to say what's going to happen
phrases.target_text: Voy a intentar decir lo que va a pasar
phrases.why: swaps matrix to going-to and verb to decir, new left neighbour

phrases.known_text: I'd like to explain what's going to happen tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Me gustaría explicar lo que va a pasar mañana
phrases.why: adds explicar as matrix verb and mañana as a right-of-LEGO tail, medial position

phrases.known_text: I want to be able to guess what's going to happen tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Quiero poder adivinar lo que va a pasar mañana
phrases.why: stacks poder before adivinar, keeps the trailing mañana medial pattern

phrases.known_text: I want to try to explain what's going to happen tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Quiero intentar explicar lo que va a pasar mañana
phrases.why: chain verb intentar with explicar, varies matrix signature

phrases.known_text: I'm going to try to guess what's going to happen in Spanish tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Voy a intentar adivinar lo que va a pasar en español mañana
phrases.why: longest right tail yet, en español mañana after the LEGO

phrases.known_text: I'd like to try to say what's going to happen in Spanish today
phrases.target_text: Me gustaría intentar decir lo que va a pasar en español hoy
phrases.why: decir as complement verb with hoy instead of mañana, new right context

phrases.known_text: I'd like to be able to explain what's going to happen with another person
phrases.target_text: Me gustaría poder explicar lo que va a pasar con otra persona
phrases.why: companion phrase con otra persona as right tail, new neighbour persona

phrases.known_text: I'm going to try to say what's going to happen in Spanish with another person
phrases.target_text: Voy a intentar decir lo que va a pasar en español con otra persona
phrases.why: combines language and companion tails after the LEGO for maximal right variety

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like
phrases.target_text: No me gustaría
phrases.why: bare matrix clause introduces the LEGO alone, initial position

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to guess
phrases.target_text: No me gustaría adivinar
phrases.why: adds adivinar as the infinitive complement, right neighbour adivinar

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to speak tomorrow
phrases.target_text: No me gustaría hablar mañana
phrases.why: swaps complement to hablar, new right neighbour distinct from adivinar

phrases.known_text: If I can't explain what I mean, I wouldn't like to try
phrases.target_text: Si no puedo explicar lo que quiero decir, no me gustaría intentar
phrases.why: fronts a conditional clause so the LEGO moves from initial to medial with a new left neighbour decir

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to guess what's going to happen tomorrow
phrases.target_text: No me gustaría adivinar lo que va a pasar mañana
phrases.why: the seed's own full realization, confirming the LEGO in its target context

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to try to explain what's going to happen
phrases.target_text: No me gustaría intentar explicar lo que va a pasar
phrases.why: chains intentar plus explicar after the LEGO, right neighbour intentar

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to practise speaking with someone else tomorrow
phrases.target_text: No me gustaría practicar hablando con otra persona mañana
phrases.why: right neighbour practicar, new gerund object

phrases.known_text: After you finish, I wouldn't like to guess what's going to happen
phrases.target_text: Después de que termines, no me gustaría adivinar lo que va a pasar
phrases.why: fronted temporal clause gives a second medial exemplar with left neighbour termines

phrases.known_text: If I can't explain what's going to happen, I wouldn't like to guess
phrases.target_text: Si no puedo explicar lo que va a pasar, no me gustaría adivinar
phrases.why: conditional built from the seed's new lo que va a pasar lego, third medial exemplar, left neighbour pasar

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to remember the whole sentence tomorrow
phrases.target_text: No me gustaría recordar toda la frase mañana
phrases.why: right neighbour recordar, new object toda la frase

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to guess how to say a word in Spanish
phrases.target_text: No me gustaría adivinar cómo decir una palabra en español
phrases.why: embedded question complement cómo decir after the LEGO, initial position with a longer tail

phrases.known_text: If I'm not sure what's going to happen, I wouldn't like to explain
phrases.target_text: Si no estoy seguro de lo que va a pasar, no me gustaría explicar
phrases.why: conditional from the no estoy seguro de matrix, fourth medial exemplar, right neighbour explicar distinct from all prior
